name: tasks
author: lumine-code
description: Run project tasks and surface their output and diagnostics.

showNotifications.title: Show Notifications
showNotifications.description: Show notifications when tasks start and when they succeed, fail or are cancelled.

additionalConfigFiles.title: Additional Task Files
additionalConfigFiles.description: Additional relative file names or paths to discover recursively alongside .lumine/tasks.json. All matching files contribute tasks.

saveOnBuild.title: Save Before Running
saveOnBuild.description: Save modified editors before starting a target.

scrollToEnd.title: Follow Output
scrollToEnd.description: Keep the newest output visible while a target runs.

maxOutputLines.title: Maximum Output Lines
maxOutputLines.description: Limit retained output to prevent long-running tasks from consuming unbounded memory.

maxOutputCharacters.title: Maximum Log Characters
maxOutputCharacters.description: Limit each retained log and compiler stream in memory.

maxHistory.title: Retained Task Logs
maxHistory.description: Keep this many completed task logs alongside active tasks.

statusBar.title: Status Bar Indicator
statusBar.description: Show the shared Tasks control for tasks, logs and observed documents.

statusBarPriority.title: Status Bar Priority
statusBarPriority.description: Set the placement priority of the status-bar indicator.
